trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Cancun
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

experiences.description: Spend a relaxing day at one of Cancun's most beautiful and uncrowded public beaches. day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Cancun International Airport at 11:00 AM on Flight AA. Clear immigration and customs, collect luggage, and take the ADO airport bus (budget-friendly option, ~$10 USD) to the Hotel Zone. Check in to Cancun Beach Resort and get settled in your room.
day_by_day.afternoon: After check-in, take a short walk to the nearest public beach access point near the hotel. Spend the afternoon relaxing on the beach, swimming in the Caribbean Sea, and soaking in your first views of the turquoise water. No entry fee for public beaches.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll along the Hotel Zone boulevard and explore the area around your hotel. Head to a local taco stand or budget-friendly restaurant near the hotel for a relaxed first dinner.

meals.breakfast: Grab a snack or light meal at the airport before or after landing — airport food courts offer affordable options around $5-8 USD.
meals.lunch: Pick up street tacos or visit a local cocina económica near the hotel for an authentic and affordable meal (~$5-7 USD).
meals.dinner: El Fish Fritanga or a nearby taqueria in the Hotel Zone offering local Mexican dishes for under $10 USD per person.

day_by_day.notes: Since the flight lands at 11:00 AM, the morning is dedicated to arrival logistics. Keep Day 1 light to recover from travel. Exchange currency at the airport or use ATMs for best rates. Avoid hotel currency exchange desks.

day_by_day.morning: Head to Playa Delfines Beach for a full beach day — one of Cancun's most beautiful and uncrowded public beaches with no entry fee. Arrive early (around 8:30-9:00 AM) to claim a good spot before it gets busy. Enjoy the stunning panoramic views of the Caribbean and the iconic Cancun sign for photos.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue relaxing at Playa Delfines. Swim, build sandcastles, or simply lounge under the sun. Rent a beach umbrella and chair from local vendors (~$5-10 USD) for comfort. Explore the beach's length and enjoy the natural scenery.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the hotel to freshen up. Walk or take a local bus (Route 1, ~$0.80 USD) to Mercado 28, a local market where you can browse souvenirs and find very affordable authentic Mexican food at the market's food court.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at a local bakery (panadería) near the hotel — fresh pan dulce and coffee for under $3 USD.
meals.lunch: Pack snacks and water from a nearby OXXO convenience store before heading to Playa Delfines, or buy from beach vendors (~$3-5 USD for snacks and drinks).
meals.dinner: Mercado 28 food court — try poc chuc, cochinita pibil tacos, or fresh ceviche for $6-10 USD per person.

day_by_day.notes: Playa Delfines is a free public beach — one of the best in the Hotel Zone. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, plenty of water, and a beach towel. There are public restrooms and a small parking area. Take the Route 1 public bus along Kukulcan Blvd for easy and cheap transport (~$0.80 USD each way).

day_by_day.morning: Take the Tulum Ruins and Beach Combo Day Trip. Book a budget group tour in advance (~$40-60 USD including transport) or take the ADO bus from the Hotel Zone bus terminal to Tulum (~$15-20 USD each way). Arrive at the Tulum Archaeological Zone (entrance fee ~$5 USD) and explore the ancient Mayan ruins dramatically perched on seaside cliffs overlooking the Caribbean.
day_by_day.afternoon: After touring the ruins, descend to the small beach below the cliffs (Playa Ruinas) for a swim in the crystal-clear turquoise water. Enjoy the stunning backdrop of the ruins above. Explore the surrounding jungle pathways and spot iguanas along the way.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Cancun by late afternoon/early evening. Freshen up at the hotel and enjoy a relaxed dinner close to the hotel. Rest up after a full day of exploring.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the hotel or a nearby café before departing for Tulum — yogurt, fruit, and coffee for ~$4-6 USD.
meals.lunch: Eat at one of the local restaurants just outside the Tulum ruins entrance — try fish tacos or a comida corrida (set lunch menu) for ~$8-12 USD.
meals.dinner: La Parrilla or a similar mid-range Mexican grill near the Hotel Zone offering fajitas and grilled meats for ~$10-15 USD per person.

day_by_day.notes: Depart early (by 7:30-8:00 AM) to maximize time in Tulum and avoid midday heat. The ADO bus is the most budget-friendly transport option. Wear comfortable walking shoes for the ruins. Bring cash for entrance fees, food, and tips. The Tulum ruins get crowded by midday, so arriving early is key.

day_by_day.morning: Explore Isla Mujeres on a budget. Take a local bus to Puerto Juárez (Route 13, ~$0.80 USD) and then the passenger ferry to Isla Mujeres (~$5-7 USD each way). Walk or rent a golf cart (~$40-50 USD for the day split among travelers) to explore the island. Visit Playa Norte, consistently rated one of the best beaches in the world — free to access.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at Playa Norte swimming in the calm, shallow, crystal-clear waters. Walk to the southern tip of the island to visit Punta Sur and the small Mayan temple ruins and lighthouse with panoramic ocean views. Browse the colorful streets and artisan shops in downtown Isla Mujeres.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the ferry back to Puerto Juárez before sunset. Return to the hotel and enjoy a sunset view from the beach near your accommodation. Have dinner at a local spot in the Hotel Zone.

meals.breakfast: Grab breakfast at a local comedor near Puerto Juárez before catching the ferry — eggs, beans, and tortillas for ~$4-5 USD.
meals.lunch: Fresh seafood at a casual beachside restaurant on Isla Mujeres — ceviche, grilled fish, or shrimp tacos for ~$10-14 USD.
meals.dinner: OXXO or local grocery store run for snacks, or a budget taqueria near the hotel for ~$6-8 USD.

day_by_day.notes: Ferries to Isla Mujeres depart frequently from Puerto Juárez (every 30 minutes). The round trip is very affordable. Playa Norte is free to access. Bring cash as some smaller vendors on the island may not accept cards. Punta Sur has a small entrance fee (~$2 USD).

day_by_day.morning: Visit Playa Tortugas or Playa Langosta — two more beautiful and accessible public beaches in the Hotel Zone. These are calmer beaches great for snorkeling near the shore. Rent basic snorkel gear from a local vendor (~$10 USD) and explore the underwater world close to shore.
day_by_day.afternoon: Walk or take the local bus to the Cancun Downtown area (El Centro) for a local cultural experience. Visit Parque Las Palapas, a lively public square where locals gather. Browse the local market stalls and pick up affordable souvenirs. Visit Mercado 23 for ultra-local and cheap food options.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a final big night out in Cancun. Walk along the Hotel Zone strip and enjoy the vibrant atmosphere. Watch the sunset from the beach. Have dinner at a mid-range restaurant and enjoy the lively Friday night energy of Cancun.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast if included, or a local café near the hotel for chilaquiles or huevos rancheros for ~$5-7 USD.
meals.lunch: Mercado 23 in Downtown Cancun — incredibly affordable local food, full meals for ~$3-5 USD.
meals.dinner: 100% Natural or a similar casual restaurant in the Hotel Zone offering fresh Mexican cuisine for ~$10-15 USD per person.

day_by_day.notes: Playa Tortugas and Playa Langosta are free public beaches easily reachable by the Route 1 bus. Downtown Cancun (El Centro) offers a very different and authentic experience compared to the Hotel Zone — highly recommended for budget travelers as prices are significantly lower.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in Cancun — enjoy one last peaceful sunrise walk on the beach near the hotel. Take a final swim in the Caribbean Sea and collect any last memories. Pack up your belongings and check out of the hotel. Store luggage at the hotel front desk if your flight is later in the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure time, spend a couple of hours at the closest beach for a final relaxing session. Do any last-minute souvenir shopping at a nearby market or OXXO. Make your way to the airport via ADO bus (~$10 USD) — allow at least 3 hours before international flight departure.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Cancun International Airport. Enjoy a final Mexican meal at the airport before your flight.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast near the hotel — fresh fruit, yogurt, or pan dulce from a local bakery for ~$3-5 USD.
meals.lunch: A final taco or torta from a street vendor or casual restaurant before heading to the airport (~$5-7 USD).
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or food court for a final meal before departure (~$10-15 USD).

day_by_day.notes: Check hotel checkout time in advance (usually 11:00 AM or 12:00 PM). Most hotels will store your luggage for free after checkout. The ADO bus from the Hotel Zone to the airport is the most budget-friendly option. Allow extra time at the airport for international check-in, security, and immigration procedures.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Cancun International Airport at 11:00 AM on Flight AA. Clear customs, collect luggage, and arrange transportation to Cancun Beach Resort. Check-in, freshen up, and get oriented with the hotel amenities and surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the hotel beach or pool to unwind after travel. Take a leisurely stroll along the Hotel Zone (Zona Hotelera) beachfront to get your bearings. Visit a nearby convenience store or mini-market to pick up essentials and snacks for the room.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxed first dinner at a casual beachfront restaurant near the hotel. Stroll along Boulevard Kukulcan in the Hotel Zone to soak in the atmosphere, browse shops, and watch the sunset over the lagoon side.

meals.breakfast: Grab a bite at the airport or a quick snack upon arrival — airport café or hotel welcome snack
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the hotel restaurant or poolside bar to settle in comfortably
meals.dinner: La Habichuela Downtown or a mid-range Hotel Zone restaurant like Labná — budget around $20–35 USD per person for authentic Yucatecan cuisine

day_by_day.notes: Since arrival is at 11:00 AM, keep Day 1 light and low-key. Early check-in may be available — call the resort ahead of time to request it. Exchange some currency or withdraw pesos from an airport ATM for tips and local purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Start the day with a full breakfast at the hotel, then head to Playa Delfines Beach Day — one of Cancun's most scenic and uncrowded public beaches. Arrive early (around 9:00 AM) to claim a good spot. Enjoy swimming in the turquoise Caribbean waters and take in the iconic Cancun sign for photos.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue relaxing at Playa Delfines or rent a beach umbrella and chairs. Grab a refreshing coconut water or snack from a nearby vendor. In the mid-afternoon, return to the hotel to freshen up and rest during the hottest part of the day.
day_by_day.evening: Book the Sunset Catamaran Cruise — board the catamaran for a scenic 2-hour cruise along the Caribbean coastline. Enjoy the open bar, snacks, and live music as the sun dips below the horizon. A perfect way to meet fellow travelers.

meals.breakfast: Full breakfast at the hotel restaurant — included or buffet style
meals.lunch: Casual beachside lunch at a palapa restaurant near Playa Delfines — try fish tacos or ceviche, budget $10–15 USD
meals.dinner: Light bites and drinks included on the Sunset Catamaran Cruise; supplement with a late snack or dessert at a Hotel Zone café afterward

day_by_day.notes: Playa Delfines is a public beach with no entry fee and is located at the southern end of the Hotel Zone — about a 15-minute taxi or bus ride from most hotels. Book the Sunset Catamaran Cruise in advance as spots fill up quickly, especially in March.

day_by_day.morning: Early start for the Isla Mujeres Snorkeling and Beach Tour. Take the ferry from Puerto Juárez or Playa Tortugas (departs around 9:00 AM). Explore the island's crystal-clear waters, snorkel with vibrant marine life including colorful fish and coral reefs, and visit MUSA (Museo Subacuático de Arte) if included in the tour.
day_by_day.afternoon: After snorkeling, arrive at Isla Mujeres town. Rent a golf cart ($40–50 USD for a few hours) to explore the island — visit Punta Sur (the southernmost tip), El Garrafón Natural Reef Park viewpoint, and the charming downtown with colorful streets. Relax on Playa Norte, consistently ranked among the world's best beaches.
day_by_day.evening: Take the ferry back to Cancun (last ferries around 8:00–9:00 PM). Enjoy dinner back in the Hotel Zone or downtown Cancun at a mid-range restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the hotel before departure — keep it light
meals.lunch: Fresh seafood lunch at a restaurant on Isla Mujeres — try the grilled lobster or fish of the day at a beachside spot on Playa Norte, budget $15–25 USD
meals.dinner: Dinner at El Fish Fritanga or Rooster's in the Hotel Zone — casual, flavorful, and mid-range priced at $15–30 USD per person

day_by_day.notes: The Isla Mujeres Snorkeling and Beach Tour typically costs $50–80 USD per person including ferry, snorkel gear, and guide. Bring reef-safe sunscreen (mandatory in Mexican waters), a waterproof bag, and cash for the golf cart rental and tips. Book the tour through the hotel concierge or a reputable local operator.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day excursion to the Tulum Ruins and Beach Combo Day Trip. Depart early (around 7:30–8:00 AM) by shuttle or organized tour. The drive to Tulum is approximately 1.5–2 hours. Arrive at the archaeological site and explore the ancient Mayan ruins perched dramatically on seaside cliffs overlooking the Caribbean — one of the most photogenic sites in Mexico.
day_by_day.afternoon: After touring the ruins, descend to the beach below for a refreshing swim in the stunning turquoise cove. Spend the afternoon relaxing on the beach or exploring Tulum town's bohemian boutiques and cenote options. Visit a nearby cenote (Gran Cenote is highly recommended, ~$20 USD entry) for a magical freshwater swimming experience if time allows.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Cancun by shuttle (arriving around 7:00–8:00 PM). Rest and freshen up at the hotel before a well-deserved dinner out.

meals.breakfast: Early grab-and-go breakfast at the hotel or pick up pastries and coffee at a local bakery before departure
meals.lunch: Lunch in Tulum town at a mid-range restaurant — try Antojitos La Chiapaneca for authentic Mexican food at great prices, budget $10–20 USD
meals.dinner: Dinner at Harry's Prime Steakhouse & Raw Bar or Porfirio's in the Hotel Zone for a slightly elevated mid-range dining experience, budget $25–40 USD per person

day_by_day.notes: The Tulum Ruins and Beach Combo Day Trip typically costs $60–100 USD per person including transportation and guided tour. Book in advance through your hotel or a certified tour operator. Wear comfortable walking shoes for the ruins, bring sunscreen, a hat, and a change of clothes for the beach. Start early to beat the crowds and midday heat.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day adventure at Xel-Ha Eco Water Park — a natural aquatic theme park built around a stunning coastal lagoon and inlet. Snorkel through the lagoon teeming with tropical fish, float down the lazy river, and explore sea caves and cliff jumping spots. Arrive when doors open (9:00 AM) to maximize your time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Xel-Ha's attractions — try the zip line over the lagoon, rent a bike to explore the park grounds, and relax in hammocks over the water. The all-inclusive entry covers food, drinks, snorkel gear, and most activities, making it excellent value for a mid-range budget.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Cancun in the late afternoon (shuttle usually departs around 5:00–6:00 PM). Spend the evening exploring the Mercado 28 downtown market for souvenirs, local crafts, and street food. Enjoy a final lively evening in Cancun.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the hotel before departure
meals.lunch: All-inclusive lunch at Xel-Ha's buffet restaurants — covered in the park entry fee
meals.dinner: Dinner at Mercado 28 or a nearby downtown Cancun restaurant — try La Parrilla for Mexican classics in a festive atmosphere with live mariachi music, budget $15–25 USD per person

day_by_day.notes: Xel-Ha all-inclusive entry costs approximately $80–110 USD per adult. Book online in advance for discounts (up to 20% off). The park is located about 1 hour south of Cancun near Tulum — shuttle transportation is usually available from major hotels. Bring reef-safe sunscreen only (regular sunscreen is prohibited to protect the ecosystem). Water shoes are recommended.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy a slow, leisurely breakfast at the hotel. Take one last swim in the Caribbean or relax by the pool. Pack your bags and check out of Cancun Beach Resort. Store luggage with the hotel concierge if your flight is later in the day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend your remaining free time doing any last-minute souvenir shopping at Plaza Las Américas mall or Mercado 28. Alternatively, revisit your favorite beach spot for a final dip. Head to the airport with plenty of time — allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for international departure.
day_by_day.evening: Depart Cancun with wonderful memories of beaches, ruins, and Caribbean adventures. Safe travels!

meals.breakfast: Full hotel breakfast — treat yourself to a nice final morning meal
meals.lunch: Casual farewell lunch at a Hotel Zone favorite — try Señor Frog's for a fun, lively atmosphere or grab tacos at a local taqueria for an authentic send-off, budget $10–20 USD
meals.dinner: Airport dining if departing in the evening, or an early dinner near the hotel before heading to the airport

day_by_day.notes: Cancun International Airport (CUN) is approximately 15–20 minutes from the Hotel Zone by taxi ($15–20 USD) or shuttle. Confirm your return flight details the night before and settle any outstanding hotel charges. Keep some pesos handy for tips and last-minute purchases. The airport has good dining and shopping options if you arrive early.

day_by_day.morning: Arrival at Cancun International Airport at 11:00 AM on Flight AA. Private luxury transfer arranged to Cancun Beach Resort. Check-in, settle into your premium suite, and enjoy a welcome amenity. Take a leisurely stroll along the hotel's private beachfront to acclimate and soak in the turquoise Caribbean views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's private beach and pool complex. Enjoy a premium beach cabana setup with personalized butler service, chilled towels, and fresh tropical fruit. Take a gentle swim in the calm Caribbean waters and begin unwinding from travel.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's rooftop or beachfront bar, savoring hand-crafted margaritas and premium spirits while watching the sun dip over the Caribbean. Followed by a relaxed welcome dinner at the resort's signature restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Light snack or coffee upon arrival at the resort's lounge
meals.lunch: La Fisheria or the resort's beachside grill — fresh ceviche, grilled fish tacos, and tropical agua frescas
meals.dinner: Hartwood Cancun or the resort's fine dining restaurant — wood-fired local seafood, artisanal cocktails, and Caribbean-inspired cuisine in an elegant open-air setting

day_by_day.notes: Arrival day — keep the schedule relaxed and flexible. Confirm all upcoming activity bookings with the resort concierge upon check-in. Request a premium ocean-view suite upgrade if not already secured. Hydrate well after the flight.

day_by_day.morning: Playa Delfines Beach Day — After a leisurely resort breakfast, arrange a private transfer to Playa Delfines, one of Cancun's most stunning and uncrowded public beaches. Arrive early to secure the best spot. Enjoy the dramatic panoramic views of the Hotel Zone skyline against the vivid turquoise sea. Swim in the clear, calm waters and relax on the pristine white sand.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue your Playa Delfines experience with a private beach picnic curated by the resort — chilled champagne, gourmet sandwiches, fresh fruit, and artisan snacks delivered in a premium hamper. Explore the scenic coastal lookout point at the beach's elevated mirador for breathtaking photo opportunities.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a luxury spa treatment — a 90-minute Caribbean hot stone massage or couples' ritual to rejuvenate after a full beach day. Followed by a premium dinner at a top Cancun restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast or à la carte eggs Benedict with smoked salmon, fresh juices, and specialty coffee at the hotel restaurant
meals.lunch: Private gourmet beach picnic hamper arranged by the resort concierge — champagne, charcuterie, fresh ceviche, and tropical fruit
meals.dinner: Porfirio's Cancun — iconic upscale Mexican cuisine with live music, premium tequila selections, and stunning lagoon views in a sophisticated atmosphere

day_by_day.notes: Playa Delfines is a public beach — arrive before 10:00 AM to claim the best spots. Apply high-SPF reef-safe sunscreen. The resort concierge can pre-arrange the gourmet picnic hamper and private beach transfer. Book the spa treatment in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Isla Mujeres Snorkeling and Beach Tour — Depart early via private luxury ferry or chartered catamaran to the enchanting island of Isla Mujeres. Upon arrival, embark on a guided premium snorkeling excursion in the crystal-clear waters of the Mesoamerican Reef, swimming alongside vibrant tropical fish, sea turtles, and colorful coral formations with top-quality snorkeling gear provided.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the charming, colorful streets of Isla Mujeres by private golf cart. Visit Punta Sur, the island's scenic southern cliff tip, and Playa Norte — consistently ranked among the Caribbean's most beautiful beaches. Lounge on the powdery white sand of Playa Norte with a beachside cocktail and enjoy the impossibly calm, shallow turquoise waters.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Cancun via private transfer in time for sunset. Freshen up at the resort before heading out for a premium dinner experience in the Hotel Zone.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort — Greek yogurt parfait, fresh tropical fruits, and espresso before departure
meals.lunch: Olivia Restaurant on Isla Mujeres — acclaimed Mediterranean-fusion cuisine with the freshest local seafood, set in a romantic garden atmosphere on the island
meals.dinner: Mocambo Cancun — celebrated upscale seafood restaurant renowned for its exceptional Gulf and Caribbean seafood, premium wine list, and elegant ambiance

day_by_day.notes: Book the private charter ferry or catamaran through the resort concierge for an exclusive experience. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a light cover-up, and waterproof sandals. The golf cart rental on Isla Mujeres is a quintessential island experience — book in advance during peak season.

day_by_day.morning: Tulum Ruins and Beach Combo Day Trip — Depart by private luxury vehicle to the ancient Mayan archaeological site of Tulum, approximately 1.5 hours south of Cancun. Enjoy an exclusive private guided tour of the dramatic clifftop ruins, learning about Mayan history and cosmology while soaking in breathtaking panoramic views of the Caribbean Sea crashing against the cliffs below.
day_by_day.afternoon: Descend to Tulum's stunning beach directly beneath the ruins — one of the most iconic and photogenic beaches in Mexico. Swim in the clear waters, relax on the white sand, and marvel at the unique backdrop of ancient ruins above. Explore the Tulum beach club scene with access to a premium beach club for loungers, shade, and refreshments.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Cancun by private transfer. Enjoy a refined evening at the resort — sunset cocktails on the terrace followed by a world-class dinner.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast — avocado toast, smoked salmon, fresh-squeezed juices, and specialty coffee before departure
meals.lunch: Hartwood Tulum — one of Mexico's most celebrated restaurants, featuring wood-fire cooking, locally sourced ingredients, and an innovative menu in an open-air jungle setting (advance reservation essential)
meals.dinner: Casa Rolandi Cancun — refined Italian-Swiss cuisine with fresh handmade pasta, premium seafood, and an exceptional wine cellar in an elegant lakeside setting

day_by_day.notes: Depart no later than 7:30 AM to arrive at Tulum before the crowds. Pre-book Hartwood Tulum well in advance as it fills up quickly. The private guided tour at Tulum ruins provides a far superior experience to group tours. Wear comfortable walking shoes for the ruins site.

day_by_day.morning: Xel-Ha Eco Water Park — Depart by private transfer to Xel-Ha, a spectacular natural aquatic park built around a stunning coastal lagoon and inlet. Snorkel through the gin-clear freshwater and saltwater channels teeming with tropical fish and marine life. The all-inclusive premium experience includes unlimited food, drinks, snorkeling gear, life vests, and access to all attractions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Xel-Ha's unique ecosystem — float lazily down the natural river channel, cliff jump from scenic platforms, explore hidden caves and cenotes within the park, and relax on the pristine beach areas. Enjoy the premium hammocks over the water and the serene natural lagoon environment.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset Catamaran Cruise — Upon returning to Cancun, board a luxury private catamaran for an exclusive sunset cruise along the Caribbean coastline. Enjoy premium open-bar service with top-shelf spirits and champagne, gourmet canapés, and a live musician as the sun sets dramatically over the water.

meals.breakfast: Light resort breakfast — fresh fruit, pastries, and coffee before the early departure
meals.lunch: All-inclusive premium dining at Xel-Ha — fresh grilled fish, Mexican specialties, tropical fruits, and unlimited beverages within the park
meals.dinner: Lorenzillo's Cancun — legendary upscale lobster and seafood restaurant perched over the lagoon, serving exceptional Caribbean lobster, premium steaks, and fine wines in a stunning waterfront setting

day_by_day.notes: Book the premium all-inclusive Xel-Ha package in advance — it includes transport, snorkeling gear, and all meals and drinks. The private sunset catamaran cruise should be booked through the resort concierge for a truly exclusive experience rather than a group tour. Bring biodegradable sunscreen as chemical sunscreens are prohibited at Xel-Ha.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning at leisure — enjoy a slow, indulgent breakfast at the resort followed by one last private beach session at the hotel's beachfront. Take a final swim in the Caribbean, collect memories, and enjoy a premium spa treatment such as a revitalizing facial or aromatherapy massage to feel refreshed for the journey home.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisurely checkout from Cancun Beach Resort with late checkout arranged (request through concierge). Spend remaining time exploring the luxury boutiques and shops in the Hotel Zone, or enjoy a final swim at the resort pool with a farewell cocktail. Private luxury transfer to Cancun International Airport for departure.
day_by_day.evening: Departure — access the premium airport lounge for a comfortable pre-flight experience with gourmet food, cocktails, and relaxation before boarding.

meals.breakfast: Grand farewell breakfast at the resort's finest restaurant — eggs your way, smoked salmon, fresh tropical fruits, premium pastries, freshly squeezed juices, and specialty coffee
meals.lunch: La Destilería Cancun — upscale Mexican cuisine with an extraordinary tequila collection, serving refined traditional dishes in an elegant atmosphere for a memorable final lunch
meals.dinner: Airport premium lounge dining or a light meal before departure

day_by_day.notes: Request late checkout (2:00–3:00 PM) from the resort in advance to maximize your final day. Arrange private airport transfer at least 3 hours before departure. Purchase any last-minute premium souvenirs such as artisan tequila, Talavera pottery, or vanilla products at the Hotel Zone boutiques. Confirm all departure logistics with the concierge the evening before.
